title: Child's Face in Cosmic Storm
description: A surreal painting features the large, realistic face of a young child with wide dark eyes and slightly open mouth, emerging from swirling clouds. The dramatic sky blends fiery red and orange clouds on the left with a bright yellow sun and greenish atmosphere on the right, creating a cosmic and apocalyptic scene.
prompt: surreal oil painting of a young child's realistic face floating in the center of a dramatic cosmic sky, fiery red and orange turbulent clouds on the left, bright glowing sun with yellow and green atmosphere on the right, dark smoke and swirling clouds surrounding the child's head, apocalyptic yet dreamlike atmosphere, visible brushstrokes, painterly style
